cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: That was close. You were nearly a dead man.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who are you?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Me? Randam Hajile. Bounty hunter.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Bounty hunter?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: A civilian who hunts for rewards. JUNKER work is dangerous.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Their numbers fall every year.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: So the government put bounties on Snatchers to enlist public help.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Of course, hunters must register first.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam, was it? Were you following me?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Detective work isn't my style. You find them. I take them out.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Regulations require your bounty hunter registration number.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll verify it.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: BH-75001. Randam Hajile. R-A-N-D-A-M H-A-J-I-L-E.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: BH-75001, Randam Hajile. Confirmed. You are a bounty hunter.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, he's already disposed of three Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Freddy makes four.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Four?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I've been at this longer than you. Don't rush it, rookie.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Here's a tip for you, Mr. JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You might already know this,

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: but their artificial skin is their weak point.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Ultraviolet light apparently makes their skin cancerous.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: So they've secured a hospital to maintain it.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Hit that hospital and you can wipe them all out.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: How do you know? I get it. You stole Gibson's information.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Never mind that. With Gibson gone, I'll need you to do the work.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: That's how it is. You're the JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Anyway, Gibson seems to have found that hospital.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: He must have left some kind of clue.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Seems to? You don't know a thing, do you, Randam?

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Finding out is your job.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I owe you one, Randam.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You can pay me back someday. See you, JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: He's a Snatcher hunter, all right.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: There's a Snatcher in him.
